feedback_history.patient_message:
Thank you for saying that... it means a lot. Sometimes just getting the words out feels like taking off a tiny bit of weight, even if the rest of the pressure is still there.

You know, my husband (who's actually staying home with the kids right now because of this economy) has been telling me to "suck it up" and do what anyone else would do. He says he'll handle things so I can focus on work. But looking at him lately, when he gets depressed or stressed, all he does is lay down on the couch and refuse to move. And since I can't physically lie there depressed every day, I feel like I'm carrying the whole house on my back while trying to keep a roof over our heads. The mortgage payments are already stressing us out, and now we're both running on empty.

It makes me feel really guilty too. When I snap at the kids or get irritable with him
feedback_history.therapist_response: It's clear you're overwhelmed and struggling. It seems like you're trapped in a cycle of exhaustion and poor self-care.
